name: Halt-resumption response
hypothesis: Enter only after tradability is restored and an approved post-resumption trigger occurs.
spec: Setup: The official feed confirms a halt and later a resumption auction or continuous reopening. Entry: Enter only after tradability is restored and an approved post-resumption trigger occurs. Exit: Apply gap stress, hard exposure caps and a short holding limit. Parameters to pre-register: halt_types, post_resume_delay, spread_limit, exposure_cap.
blocked_reason: needs a licensed event feed (earnings surprises, consensus, filings, auction or halt data) with receipt times
